blurb: Cosley Zoo provides educational programs featuring live animal ambassadors, supporting Illinois State Learning Standards for ages 3 and up. Programs include school and group visits, scout badge programs, and individual experiences like Zookeeper for a Day and Morning Chores. The zoo is home to farm animals and native wildlife and offers year-round programming.
